title: Wall and Ceiling Treatment Area by IICRC Class, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
In Water Damage Mitigation work the surfaces wetted follow the IICRC class, and so does the wall and ceiling area a tear-out antimicrobial line treats.

## Standard
The surfaces wetted follow the IICRC class: on a Class 3 job, where water came from above, the treated wall and ceiling area is the baseboard run on the job's baseboard removal lines times 8 feet of wall height plus the affected floor area again for the ceiling; on a Class 2 job it is the baseboard run times 2 feet of wicking height; on any other job no class-based wall or ceiling area is treated.

The baseboard run is the total linear feet on the job's baseboard removal lines; the class and the affected floor area are those recorded on the job.

## By class
| IICRC class on the job record | Treated wall and ceiling area |
|---|---|
| Class 3 | baseboard run multiplied by 8 feet, plus the affected floor area |
| Class 2 | baseboard run multiplied by 2 feet |
| Class 1 or Class 4 | none under this standard |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: baseboard run of 90 linear feet, affected floor area of 500 square feet)
- Class 3: 90 multiplied by 8 is 720, plus 500 for the ceiling, giving 1220 square feet.
- Class 2: 90 multiplied by 2, giving 180 square feet.
- Class 4: no wall or ceiling area under this standard.
